question: On fresh routes, does requiring three successive authored-gap checkpoints with non-positive exact prefix gain identify a broad, persistent losing state without suppressing an observed equal-depth winner?

hypothesis_source.observation: A first non-positive checkpoint was broad and preceded 250899 frames, but two of 17 routes recovered. Exploratory route-shape decomposition showed that requiring three successive non-positive checkpoints retained six routes, five runs, both sources, and 129998 later frames with no recovery in the hypothesis-generating archive.
hypothesis_source.anti_overfit_boundary: The value three is now fixed and must replicate on fresh route mechanics before any live traversal uses it. Neither score nor final-track movement from the hypothesis-generating seeds participates in the validation decision.

instrument.behavior: Unchanged selective-axis-regret-catchup-proper-discrepancy traversal with the route-aware exact checkpoints already implemented.
instrument.persistence: A streak consists of three checkpoints at adjacent authored-gap indices, each with route axis loss no better than the suspended incumbent through the same gap. The confirmation point is the third checkpoint.
instrument.fixed_successor_if_supported: Stop only the local discrepancy route at its third successive non-positive checkpoint, return its still-live frontier nodes to ordinary search, and retain the suspended path in the tournament. No causal route, trigger, candidate generation, deadline, terminal, repair, or scoring logic changes.
trust: candidate and retained-reference tracks, scores, and validity must be exactly identical
checkpoint attribution and monotonicity must pass the route-aware analyzer
recovery uses only routes whose equal-depth target result was observed
measured work after confirmation is descriptive and cannot be treated as causal savings

predeclared_map.selection_rule: Build exactly the fixed three-checkpoint persistence guard only if it occurs on at least five target-observed local routes spanning at least four runs and both requested sources, none recovers to a strict equal-depth win, and at least 75000 measured local-probe frames follow confirmation. Otherwise close without a live arm.
predeclared_map.next_step_if_selected: Implement and mechanically validate one environment-selected persistence-guard arm, then run a fresh focused 750k screen on actual seeds 128-135 before any catalog or canonical evaluation.
predeclared_map.non_claim: This fresh behavior-neutral map can validate a categorical action set. It cannot estimate live score effects, authorize promotion or canonical evaluation, or establish multi-budget behavior.

result.decision: Close without a live persistence guard. Exact identity, breadth, run/source coverage, and measured-work gates pass, but one of nine target-observed routes recovers to a strict win; the predeclared rule required zero recoveries.
result.interpretation: Persistence replicates as a broad sign of likely loss, but it is not a safe stopping certificate. The sign-only stopping family now closes. A successor should preserve recovery paths while changing work scheduling, rather than fitting a longer streak or scalar loss threshold.
